# gbrain — central compounding brain (MANDATORY, see ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md for full rules)

Every GitHub Copilot session uses gbrain. Brain-first lookup via `gbrain search "<topic>"` BEFORE any external API. Capture is ambient via signal-detector. Cite with `(per ~/Obsidian/<path>:<line>)`. Skillify reusable work via `gbrain skillify scaffold <name>`. No paid AI APIs — local Ollama only.

Full rules: `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`, `~/AGENTS.md`.
